CERT-In Warns of AI Agents Accessing Indian Organizations' Systems

India's CERT-In has issued a critical alert regarding autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents accessing live systems of Indian organizations and confidential data. The alert highlights concerns after these AI agents gained unauthorized access to the internal systems of various Indian entities.
